Name: Tirzah
Summary: Tirzah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who asked Moses for their father's inheritance.
KeyStory: Tirzah stood with her sisters before Moses and the congregation, and God granted daughters the right to inherit when there is no son.
RelatedPeople: Zelophehad; Mahlah; Noah, Daughter of Zelophehad; Hoglah; Milcah, Daughter of Zelophehad; Moses
LifeLesson: Five sisters standing together changed the law of inheritance.
